WITH total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
), circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT
    circuitId,
    AVG(round) AS average_round,
    COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
)
SELECT
  circuitId,
  average_round,
  race_count,
  1.0 * race_count / (SELECT race_count FROM total) AS share
FROM circuit_counts
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
